title: Riot Axe
specs: Only facility in Guelph accredited by International Axe Throwing Federation (IATF)
Licensed facility with local beer, cider, and coolers
Offers axe throwing leagues with national competition opportunities
Minimum age 12 to participate; under 18 must be accompanied by parent/guardian
Minors must be accompanied by parent or legal guardian
Youths 12+ must demonstrate ability to throw safely
No toddlers or young children under 12 allowed; infants not yet mobile allowed with ear protection encouraged
Failure to follow safety rules or staff instructions may result in expulsion without refund
Private events minimum 6 people, maximum 28 including spectators
Private events have exclusive use of the facility

blurb: Guests participate in axe throwing with safety instructions and coaching. Private events include practice and a knockout tournament. The facility is licensed and allows guests to bring their own food but not outside alcohol.
extraNote: Cancellation within 1 week incurs $50 late cancellation fee charged to credit card used for reservation · Payment due at end of visit; cash, credit, debit accepted · No outside alcoholic beverages allowed; licensed facility serving local beer, cider, coolers · Spectators welcome free of charge · Must sign waiver on arrival · Open by appointment only for private events and league nights · 101 Beverley St, Suite D, Guelph, Ontario, N1E 3C3. Drive through the wire fence gate to find us.
